## Change

Describe the problem and link the issue, if any.

## Validation

List commands run and results. Distinguish core tests, real-gateway tests,
and live-model checks; include the relevant Nomos/model versions.

## Compatibility And Safety

Describe any policy, approval, persistence, or dependency changes. For a tool
change, verify denial prevents side effects and retries preserve idempotency.
Do not attach credentials, databases, or private session data.
